title: Behind Story
description: After Johann endures a brutal murder-suicide attempt by his own division teacher, a scandal involving his school escalates into a nationwide uproar. To Taehee's distress, Johann vanishes for three years. Both boys mature into men, leading separate lives. Taehee finds work at a nightclub alongside the charming bartender Jungin. In contrast, the isolated Johann remains under the radar. One day, Taehee and Johann catch sight of one another. But Taehee's envious friend Dooyong is determined to keep the two men apart.

title: Behind the Stage
description: Jin-woo, a hardworking model student, makes the decision to go clubbing for the very first time. Under the influence of alcohol, Jin-woo ends up having an impulsive one-night stand with the first attractive man he meets, only to find himself alone in an empty room the following morning. On the bedside table are several 50,000 won bills. Perplexed, Jin-woo presumes he has been paid for s** and is filled with anger, but chooses to push the incident to the back of his mind. After he returns to university, Jin-woo assists his juniors with their performance and locks eyes with a familiar figure on stage. It's the man from that night whom he believed he would never encounter again, Kwon Tae-young. Then, in front of everyone, Tae-young exclaims with a glint in his eye: "Found you."

title: Suimenka
description: The story revolves around three boys and their challenging encounters with love.

title: Behind the Scenes
description: In an extravagant annual production covertly financed by the mafia, the once-prominent actor Lu Huaming finds himself unexpectedly chosen for the role of the second male lead, sharing the screen with the immensely popular actor, Lu Zuo. However, delays in filming test the patience of everyone involved, particularly Long Xiaoyue—the project’s supervisor and the son of the mafia boss. Frustrated with Huaming’s unimpressive acting skills, Long Xiaoyue quickly grows antagonistic towards him. Nevertheless, as their exchanges become more frequent, Long Xiaoyue starts to sense that Huaming is burdened by a hidden and painful past.

title: Behind the Lens
description: In New York, private investigator Noah Yoon is drawn into turmoil during his investigation of a fraud case at WPC when he encounters the charming CEO Egon Wagner. At the same time, Meanwhile Mason, his best friend since childhood who harbors secret feelings for Noah, recognizes the threat and resolves to compete for Noah's affection.

title: Behind the Curtains
description:
I got to see my neighbor's inside life by chance. What's happening to her? Why can't I take her off my mind?

(Source: Toomics)

title: Old Life Behind
description:
I came to kill myself after I lost my life savings investing in cryptocurrency... Goodbye world... Wait, who's that girl?

(Source: Toomics)

title: Behind The Gifs
description: During their adventurous journey through the dusty catacombs of a Pharaoh's tomb, fearless explorers AC Stuart and Kat Swenski stumbled upon an ancient artifact that granted them the ability to uncover the narratives behind any animated GIF. In another event, they were bitten by a radioactive cartoonist. Together, they harness their unique powers to delve into the reality Behind the GIF.

title: Behind the Scandal
description: Chan’s always been the one to blend in, unlike his friend Dowoon the celebrity. From the States, Dowoon’s always gotten attention wherever he goes for his height and his looks. It’s really no surprise Chan fell for him at first sight… but he’s been keeping his feelings a secret since high school. But then one day, just like that, Dowoon asks Chan to be his boyfriend. Bewildered, Chan tries to laugh it off as a joke but he can’t seem to stop thinking about it. Then on the very same day, Chan comes across an article saying Dowoon is romantically involved with some other woman. Was Dowoon being serious about what he said, or was he simply playing a mean prank? Just what could his mixed signals mean? What’s going on behind the scandal?

title: Behind the Curtain
description: Juyeon has feelings for the new member of the theater club, Sol. Everything appears to be progressing well until Juyeon’s former girlfriend, Minkyeong, joins the club and approaches Juyeon with dubious motives. As if encountering Minkyeong wasn’t challenging enough, the three of them are asked to take part in a play, “The Maids” by Jean Genet, for the annual theater club showcase. Will Juyeon manage to navigate their complicated relationships and discover love?

title: Behind Iron Bars
description: Jin Hyuk, who has spent his life depending on wealthy women, finds himself imprisoned for three years following a conviction for fraud and theft. As he adjusts to his new reality behind bars, he risks becoming someone's prison bitch due to his attractive looks. Seok Jun, infamous for being incarcerated for murder, comes to his aid in a tough spot. From that moment on, Jin Hyuk resolves to stay close to him for protection... which turns out to be a significant mistake.

title: Behind The Desks
description: On his first day working as a new teacher at his alma mater, Sunny Day Boys High School, Lee Taesung is welcomed by the bright and sunny smile of Seo Sunny, a warmhearted chemistry teacher. Feeling immediately drawn to Sunny, who resembles his first love from high school, Taesung tries to hold back his feelings by keeping his distance. But still, Taesung can't help but be pulled in by Sunny's irresistible charm..

title: The Time Between Dog and Wolf
description: .Han Kiyo (21) was unexpectedly taken into custody due to his series of "Dark joke" creations on social media platforms... As a struggling artist, he painted anything to make a living, but it resulted in a backlash. Despite insufficient evidence, he was declared guilty and imprisoned; however, due to an error in the official process, he ended up in an alpha-only prison, placing him in a very challenging predicament.

title: Behind the Scenes (Gunsu)
description: Behind the Stage / Stage Behind / Tras bambalinas /  /   Straight-laced honor student Jinwoo decides to break the rules just once, and steps into a club for the first time in his life. One drunken mistake leads to him spending a passionate night with a strikingly handsome stranger - the next morning, he wakes up alone in an empty roomwith a pile of cash on the nightstand. Shocked and humiliated, Jinwoo assumes the worst, and buries the memory deep in his heart. Back at school, Jinwoo volunteers for a student performanceonly to lock eyes with someone on stage. It's him. The man from that night, and the king of campus: Kwon Taeyeong. It's then that, in front of everyone and with a glint in his eye, Taeyeong smiles and utters two words that will change the course of both of their lives forever: "Found you." (Source: Lezhin)Original WebtoonOfficial Translations:English, Spanish, Thai, Fench, Japanese##### NOTE: All official translations are uncensored, except for Japanese.

title: The Truth Behind the Sadistic Prince
description: Natalia, the daughter of a Count, cannot stand the idea of marriage. This aversion stems from her ability to perceive people's emotions as colors in their aura. While her maids appear to smile, they radiate red with animosity, and her kind instructors are tinged with the hue of anger. This inability to trust leads Natalia to ruin her debutante ball, ultimately retreating into seclusion. Concerned for her wellbeing, her younger brother Julian takes her to a ball thrown by a member of the royal family. However, the overwhelming combination of colors and auras makes Natalia feel nauseous. Suddenly, she notices an aura filled with red anger and black hatred! It's the most intense aura she has ever encountered, completely hiding the individual responsible. Natalia stands frozen, shaking as the figure comes closer. To her shock, she realizes it is His Highness Prince Ludwig...?!

title: The Knight Blooms Behind Castle Walls
description: Rosa aspires to don armor and become a valiant knight! However, she must begin her journey as a squire first. The responsibilities at the castle are far from glamorous. One minute she is tending to the horses in the stable, and the next she is tackling the chore of chopping firewood or overcoming a pile of laundry. She must always be prepared to help the knight she is assigned to! Although her position may appear minor and the chores routine, each task is a crucial step on her path to knighthood. Rosa is determined to confront every obstacle with the spirit of a hero!

title: Can you feel it from behind?
description: Seojun, a college student, is popular with men. But, the problem is... He's not popular with women. He tries to get closer to the girls at the opening general meeting, but they are focused on someone else, yunwoo, a schoolmate of his. Envious of Yunwoo, Seojun gets wasted. And when he opens his eyes, Yunwoo appears unusually softer. He gets a strange sensation in his a**..."Seojun Hyung, can you feel it?""Why is this guy behind me?!"

title: Door no Mukou ni wa Romance {Eng} Romance is Just Behind the Door
description: When Kagami decides to call an escort service for a hotel visit one evening, the person who arrives at his door appears to be exactly his type. However, his excitement quickly dissipates when he discovers that Minato is actually a food delivery boy who has mistakenly come to his room. Not wanting to miss out on this rare opportunity, Kagami playfully kisses Minato as a joke. But when Minato unexpectedly arrives the following day to deliver food to his house, Kagami finds himself increasingly attracted to this charming and honest boy.

title: Ushiro no Shōmen Kamui-san
description: Shizuka is a normal schoolgirl who can see ghosts. She works as an assistant to a famous exorcist named Kamui-san. Kamui-san's exorcism technique is ......... unique.

title: Behind His Kind Mask
description: As the number one stalker of Pope Ulysses, the kind-hearted male lead, Yoidel was sentenced to death for her offenses. Just moments before her execution, Yoidel manages to escape her cell to seek assistance from Ulysses, only to encounter a bloodthirsty madman... who surprisingly is the male lead himself! In a frantic effort to survive, Yoidel forges a magical contract with him, binding their fates together and condemning them to share both their lives and their deaths. Now entangled with a duplicitous psycho, will Yoidel discover a way to sever their connection before it leads to her own destruction?
